keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Estrela 0, Benfica 1. Gianluca Prestianni (Benfica) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Claudio Echeverri.
First Half ends, Estrela 0, Benfica 1.
Goal! Estrela 1, Benfica 1. Lovro Zvonarek (Estrela) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Rafa Soares following a fast break.
Lovro Zvonarek (Estrela) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Benfica. Alessandro Circati replaces Tomás Araújo.
Substitution, Benfica. Dodi Lukébakio replaces Claudio Echeverri.
Substitution, Estrela. Alisson Souza replaces Ianis Stoica.
Substitution, Estrela. Joan Jordán replaces Santiago Serra.
Own Goal by Bernardo Schappo, Estrela. Estrela 1, Benfica 2.
Goal! Estrela 2, Benfica 2. Leandro Antonetti (Estrela) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Joan Jordán with a cross following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Benfica. Andreas Schjelderup replaces Rafa.
Substitution, Benfica. Jhon Durán replaces Alexander Bah.
Substitution, Benfica. Daniel Banjaqui replaces Samuel Dahl.
Substitution, Estrela. Tom Moustier replaces Kevin Höög Jansson because of an injury.
Substitution, Estrela. Atanas Chernev replaces Bernardo Schappo because of an injury.
Substitution, Estrela. Jefferson Encada replaces Leandro Antonetti.
Alisson Souza (Estrela) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Estrela 2, Benfica 3. Vangelis Pavlidis (Benfica) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Andreas Schjelderup with a cross following a corner.
Second Half ends, Estrela 2, Benfica 3.
